artworks.title: Bathing Maiden
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lush, densely vegetated landscape with a tree in the foreground, finely detailed in texture. In the center-left, a nude figure stands with their back to the viewer, surrounded by various foliage. The horizon is not distinct, and the scene is filled with greenery. The engraving features intricate line work, creating a texture-rich depiction of natural elements. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray to highlight the details of the surroundings.

artworks.title: Straw-Thatched Hut with Landscape and Figures
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a thatched-roof cottage surrounded by trees. The dense canopy obscures the horizon. The drawing style is detailed, using fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The scene is in black and white. Three figures are in front of the cottage, with detailed clothing and gestures. The composition balances the natural and human elements.

artworks.title: The Damned
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 41.1 x 32.3 cm (16 3/16 x 12 11/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple nude figures in a chaotic scene. The composition shows figures in dynamic poses against a stormy background. One figure appears to be carrying or dragging another, while various limbs and torsos are intertwined. Some figures reach upwards with outstretched arms. Dark clouds and hints of lightning add to the intense atmosphere. The overall tone is dark and foreboding, evoking a sense of struggle or battle.

artworks.title: Der Polster (The Cushion)
artworks.medium: colour woodcut on thin Japanese tissue, attached to a dark brown support sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a green and yellow patterned sofa. The person has their back to the viewer, leaning forward with their head resting on their crossed arms. They have dark hair and wear a long gray dress. In their lap, there is a white cloth with green lines and yellow shapes. The background has a reddish-brown upper wall and a greenish patterned lower wall, complementing the sofa.

artworks.title: Springtime Storm
artworks.medium: colour woodcut in beige and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut print of a Gothic-style church. The horizon is low, emphasizing the structure against the sky. The point of view is near the ground, showing the church's facade, windows, and trees. The bold lines typical of woodcuts add texture. The color scheme is black and white. A figure in period dress is near us, with trees in the background. The sky has dynamic lines hinting at movement.

artworks.title: Sonnenuntergang (Alb)
artworks.medium: woodcut on buff wove paper

artworks.title: Standing Male Nude and Two Female Nudes
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a person standing with arms crossed, facing left but looking over their shoulder. The figure's facial features are slightly abstract with prominent eyebrows and lips, and short hair. The person appears unclothed, with sketch-like lines defining the body. Faint outlines of other figures or forms surround the main figure in an abstract, unfinished style. The background is a textured, neutral-toned surface.

artworks.title: Badende mit Kopf auf Knie (Bather with Her Head on Her Knee)
artworks.medium: drypoint on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting down, with their body curled inward. The individual is in a seated position with knees bent, arms wrapped around the legs, and head resting on the knees, turned slightly to the side. The person's facial features are soft and understated, with closed eyes and a serene expression. The hair appears to be styled into a simple, smooth updo. The person has a nude form, and the image focuses on the contours and outlines of the body without detailing any clothing or additional objects. The background is a plain, textured surface that provides a minimalistic setting, highlighting the figure's position and form without additional context or detail.

artworks.title: Resting Travelers in a Mountainous Landscape
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a young person seated amidst lush vegetation and rocky terrain, with trees, a rocky cliff, a river or stream, and a dynamic sky with clouds in the background. The scene is depicted with detailed brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette in shades of brown, resembling an etching or engraving.

artworks.title: A Tavern Garden in Rosenheim
artworks.medium: etching on wove cream paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering under trees. The scene shows numerous people seated at long tables. Towering trees provide shade, with sunlight creating patterns on the ground and foliage. A building is visible in the background, with open windows. The drawing is done in a monochromatic palette with a focus on contrast and shading, accentuating the texture of the trees and the gathering. The style conveys a lively yet tranquil atmosphere, typical of outdoor social gatherings.

artworks.title: The Jewish Quarter in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching on laid cream paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street market with various figures engaging in activities. The urban setting features tall buildings framing the scene. The street is busy with market stalls, some covered with awnings, and figures interacting or shopping. The sketch emphasizes movement and a vibrant atmosphere, capturing daily urban life with spontaneity and intricacy.

artworks.title: Lizards
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on grey-green Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of bold, dark shapes and lines forming various interconnected patterns on a light background in an abstract composition. Curved lines arc across the left side, resembling a large crescent or curved horn, while a series of interlocking rectangles and circles intertwine in the center. The right side features elements that suggest the form of a human figure wearing a hat, with lines hinting at a stance or posture. Swirls at the bottom evoke the appearance of waves or clouds, and sharp, angular forms in the upper corners could be reminiscent of stars or floral patterns.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape with a Pair of Shepherds
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view among large trees. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dense tree cover. In the distance, there is a field leading to hills with a structure resembling a temple. The brushstrokes are detailed, with intricate details in foliage and bark. The color scheme is monochromatic, with contrasts of light and shadow in black, white, and grey. The scene includes two figures in a sunlit glade among the trees.

artworks.title: Two Peasant Girls
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child sitting on the grass. The woman is facing the child, with her hands on her lap. She has medium-length hair and is wearing a patterned dress with a necklace. The child is seated to the left, with a slight downward head tilt. Also wearing a patterned dress, the child has hands clasped together in front of the chest. The background includes tall grasses and thin trees with sparse leaves.

artworks.title: Seated Old Woman
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a chair, facing the viewer. The person is positioned centrally in the image, sitting upright with hands resting on their knees. The face is partially shadowed due to a hood covering most of the head. The person is dressed in a dark, long garment that covers the body entirely, with long sleeves and a hood. The background is dark and textured with a blurred silhouette of trees or large shrubs and a building behind the person.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees
artworks.medium: drypoint, etching and roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a grove of trees with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is positioned below the top third of the image, revealing tree trunks and small structures or fences in the distance. The artwork uses sketch-like brushstrokes to depict circular and swirling patterns for the foliage and rippling lines for the ground. The color palette consists of shades of brown and sepia, creating a vintage and textured appearance. The incline of the land and dark outlines of the tree trunks guide the eye into the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Acker mit Weib (Woman in a Field)
artworks.medium: woodcut on Japan tissue
artworks.description: Irregular, jagged black shapes are spread across a cream-colored background in this image. The abstract nature of the artwork resembles a network of cracks or veins. The composition appears dynamic, with sharp edges and scattered formations creating a sense of movement and depth.

artworks.title: Crucifixion with Horseback Rider
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid tissue paper

artworks.title: Lastträgerin
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid tissue paper

artworks.title: Flagellation
artworks.medium: linocut printed in blue on laid tissue paper
artworks.description: The image features fluid, interlocking shapes and lines in an abstract composition. Swirling forms and jagged edges create a dynamic visual, reminiscent of tree branches or pathways on a map viewed from above. Dark, bold outlines define the shapes, while lighter spaces within suggest a continuous flow. Triangular patterns appear in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Crucifixion I
artworks.medium: linocut printed in blue on laid tissue paper
artworks.description: The image displays sharp, angular shapes and bold lines in an abstract composition. On one side, there are shapes resembling a canine standing on its hind legs surrounded by elongated figures that resemble hooded or robed people. The scene suggests an interaction between these figures, creating a tableau that resembles a gathering or ritualistic setting.

artworks.title: Christ before the High Council
artworks.medium: linocut printed in blue on laid tissue paper
artworks.description: The image displays interconnected black lines and shapes forming a central circular pattern, with vertical extensions creating an impression of multiple humanoid figures. The composition suggests a gathering of figures in motion or engaged in a communal activity, maintaining a sense of abstraction through simplified outlines and a lack of detailed features.

artworks.title: Bärtiger Mann
artworks.medium: linocut in black on beige wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of jagged, swirling shapes and lines converging to form an abstract composition on a solid black background. The shapes resemble a face with wild, protruding hair, a beard, and facial contours. The lighter shapes against the dark backdrop give the impression of a face emerging from shadow.

artworks.title: Brücke 1912 Pechstein
artworks.medium: portfolio cover with color woodcut printed in gold-yellow on black wove paper
artworks.description: The image contains bold, angular lines and shapes, with the words "Brücke" and "Pechstein" and the numbers "1910" displayed prominently. There is a seated human figure resembling a woman with her knees bent and arms resting behind her. This abstract composition features a style defined by stark contrast and minimalistic execution, evoking a sense of fragmented reality through artistic abstraction.
